outcome: CD8+ T-cell infiltration in placental villous tissue
CD79a+ B-cell infiltration in placental villous tissue
cohort: The study included 871 individual, singleton pregnancies, with cases of small-for-gestational age or pre-eclampsia matched with healthy controls, and a subset of FGR cases and preterm deliveries.
finding: Fetal growth restriction and pre-eclampsia are associated with increased T-cell infiltration and placental pathological abnormalities, while B-cell infiltration is only increased in FGR.
birth_weight: Cases included small-for-gestational age (SGA) and fetal growth restriction (FGR), implying varying birth weights compared to controls.
gest_age: Cases included preterm delivery and small-for-gestational age (SGA), implying varying gestational ages, with analysis performed blind to gestational age.
